title: Austin Street Paving and Building Permits Approved
summary:
• **Street Infrastructure Investment**: The council approved a $1,257.40 appropriation to pave East 6th Street, representing a significant infrastructure investment for the growing city.

• **Building Permits Granted**: Two local residents, S.L. Costley and Geo Balagia, received permission to construct buildings within Austin's fire district after approval from the Fire Commissioners.

• **Tax Assessment Corrections**: The council cancelled erroneous 1908 tax assessments against nine insurance and financial companies, instructing city officials to adjust their records accordingly.

• **Minor Budget Adjustments**: The council approved a $50 engineering expenditure and transferred $20 in street damages paid by Ringling Bros. circus to the proper city fund.

Galveston, THe Texas Life Ins Co of Waco,
The Guarantee Life Ins Co of Houston,
The Union Bank and Trust Co of Dallas,
The Bond Guarantee Co of Dallas,

S L Costley & The Council was called to order by the Mayor,with all members present.
Geo Balagia Councilman Hart presented petitions of S L Costley and Geo Balagia for

Austin,Texas Nov 24th 1909.
Allma paving East The Council was called to order by the Mayor with all members present.
6th street The Mayor laid before the Council an ordinance appropriating the sum of $
1257.40 for the purpose of paving East 6th street.
The ordinance was read the third time and passed by the following vote: Yeas Mayor
Wooldridge,Councilmen Bartholomew,Gracy,Hart & Powell 5 Nays none.

Councilman Gracy offered the following resolution: Treasurer to transfer Be it resolved bt
yhe City Council of the City of Austin : That funds. the City Treasurer be and he is

Bartholomew,Gracy,Hart & Powell 5 Nays none.
